title: Practice 4: In an hour, a week ago, for two days

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: «The preposition через means „across, over, through“. In time expressions it means „in“, „after“. This preposition is used with the accusative case: Я буду там через неделю.» And with после: «„через“ + Acc. in combination with „после“ + Gen. denotes the time of one event taking place after some other event.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 47 (p. 137) and 77.  ·  From Фёдор Достоевский, «Преступление и наказание».
exercises.context: ЧЕРЕЗ + Accusative: in time expressions it means “in”, “after”. (DLI, Lessons 47 (p. 137) and 77)

exercises.q: Варгас Жетулиу застрелился более тридцати ___ (годы) назад.
exercises.prompt: Getúlio Vargas killed himself with a gun more than thirty years ago.
exercises.why: «For the genitive plural of the noun год the word лет is used: один год, два года, пять лет.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 41.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: For the genitive plural of год the word лет is used. (DLI, Lesson 41)

exercises.q: Под Якутском больше чем на ___ (сутки) задержала нас сильная буря.
exercises.why: «The preposition НА + Acc. is used: (a) to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last; (b) after the verb опаздывать / опоздать to indicate the amount of time by which someone is late.» «Note also such expressions as: на следующий день — (next day).» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 73.
exercises.context: НА + Accusative indicates how long something is expected to last. (DLI, Lesson 73)

exercises.why: «The preposition ЗА + Acc. denotes the time that it takes to accomplish an action.» «„ЗА + Acc.“ is also used in combination with „ДО + Gen.“ to denote the time of one event taking place before some other event: Он умер за год до войны.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 77.
exercises.context: ЗА + Accusative denotes the time that it takes to accomplish an action. (DLI, Lesson 77)

exercises.q: Сейчас еще мал, но через ___ (год) попрошу — может, примут.
exercises.why: «The preposition через means „across, over, through“. In time expressions it means „in“, „after“. This preposition is used with the accusative case: Я буду там через неделю.» And with после: «„через“ + Acc. in combination with „после“ + Gen. denotes the time of one event taking place after some other event.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 47 (p. 137) and 77.  ·  From Николай Островский, «Как закалялась сталь».
exercises.context: ЧЕРЕЗ + Accusative: in time expressions it means “in”, “after”. (DLI, Lessons 47 (p. 137) and 77)

exercises.q: У меня была внематочная беременность два ___ (год) назад.
exercises.prompt: I had an ectopic pregnancy two years ago.
exercises.why: «In expressions answering the questions „How long?“ and „How long ago?“ the accusative case is used: Я был там год. — Я был там год тому назад.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 41. «2, 3, 4 + Gen. sing.; 5 and up + Gen. plur.»: «After три and четыре… the noun is also in the genitive singular… After all other numerals (пять, шесть, семь, etc.)… the noun is in the genitive plural.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 39.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: “How long ago?” — the accusative, followed by (тому) назад. (DLI, Lesson 41)

exercises.q: Судя по степени разложения останков, коня пристрелили где-то ___ (неделя) назад.
